key_insight: 3D coupled opto-electro-thermal simulation shows lead-free MgXS3 (X = Ti, Zr, Hf) chalcogenide perovskites can deliver high-efficiency solar cells with strong thermal robustness.
engineering_relevance: The study provides device-design guidance on absorber thickness, doping, defect density, and BSF integration for scalable, non-toxic perovskite solar architectures.
method: Self-consistent coupling of optical generation, drift-diffusion transport, and heat transfer
Parametric optimization of absorber and BSF layers under AM 1.5G illumination
evidence_signal: Optimized devices reached simulated PCEs of 26.72% to 28.18% with detailed JSC, VOC, and FF values reported for each MgXS3 composition.
watch_item: The results are simulation-based and depend on assumed material parameters, so experimental validation and defect/thermal stability control are still needed.
paper_title: Numerical exploration on unveiling the photovoltaic potential of MgXS3(X = Ti, Zr, Hf) chalcogenide perovskites
